climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: A Bordeaux appellation in Entre-Deux-Mers, across thirty-nine communes including Bassens, Baurech and Bouliac. Its wines are made from Sémillon, Sauvignon, Sauvignon Gris and Muscadelle.
